title: Musk’s xAI is being sued over its data center generators — now it’s buying $2.8B more
brief: xAI will purchase $2.8 billion in natural gas turbines over three years to power its data center operations, as disclosed in SpaceX's IPO filing. The investment comes amid an ongoing lawsuit over the company's existing generators, signaling xAI's rapid infrastructure buildout to support its growing AI operations.
